Subject: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM and access guardrails

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving forward with Redwood for inference serving and need to kick off the access controls work so our security/compliance team can close their review. Primary asks:

- SSO (SAML) integration with our identity provider (Okta)
- SCIM provisioning for group and service-account sync
- IP allowlist for management endpoints and a plan for service accounts with least privilege
- Audit logging retention and where logs will be stored

Can you share a proposed sequencing and any artifacts you need from our side (SAML metadata, test users, network ranges)? Procurement is looped for contract items but Security will be the one approving technical design.

Regards,
Alice Bates
Head of Cloud Security — Brightline Financial
alice.bates@brightlinefin.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM and access guardrails

Hi Alice — great to hear the internal greenlight is moving along.

I've pulled together a short sequencing we typically run for enterprise accounts — attaching the checklist and a mutual action plan grid. High level:

1) Exchange SAML metadata and validate the assertion mapping (we'll send a test SP metadata).
2) Configure IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows in a staging tenant.
3) Enable SCIM with a scoped service account (read/write groups, user profile attributes only).
4) Apply IP allowlist for control-plane endpoints (we'll provide CIDR examples), and sandbox any IP exceptions with a timeboxed window.
5) Configure audit-log exports to your SIEM (S3/HTTP), retention policy confirmation.
6) Cutover weekend + rollback plan.

Action items for Brightline: share Okta org admin access for testing (or send metadata + test user), list of management CIDRs, and any SCIM attribute mapping preferences.

I'll have Marissa take point on the SAML metadata exchange. Monica will own SCIM mapping and service-account least-privilege. Jordan will coordinate the rollouts with Dedicated infra if you want reserved capacity pinned during the cutover.

Proposed timeline: 2–3 week staging/setup, 1 week user acceptance, weekend cutover. We can compress if you provide early access to test accounts.

I'll attach: redwood-sso-scim-checklist.pdf and mutual-action-plan-BLF-DEAL-0042.xlsx.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Thanks Rafael — that sequencing looks good. A couple clarifications from Security:

- SCIM: we only allow provisioning of group membership and email/employeeID. No profile photo or sensitive attrs.
- Service accounts: must be scoped to a single project and rotate keys every 90 days; we want a short doc showing how Redwood enforces least privilege.
- IP allowlist: we will provide management CIDRs, but need an exception path for our external data-collection agents (approx. 3 static IPs).

Procurement also asked for a timeline for SOC2 evidence requests — where should they upload those docs?

I'll upload the Okta metadata to the Drive folder and grant read-only to marissa.cole@redwood.com and monica.patel@redwood.com.

-Alice

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM and access guardrails

Hi Alice,

Thanks — I can confirm read access to the Drive folder. We'll start with SAML attribute mapping and share a test SP metadata (attached) for your dev Okta tenant. A few practical notes:

- For SCIM we will create a service account that only has the /scim/v2/Groups and /scim/v2/Users scope. We'll provide a scoped bearer token and instructions for rotation.
- Key rotation: we support manual rotation now; automated rotation is on the roadmap (ETA Q3). We'll document the manual flow and recommended cron job pattern.
- Audit logs: we can export to an S3 bucket you manage (preferred) or stream to an HTTP endpoint on your SIEM. Retention defaults to 90 days — we can extend if required (cost impact flagged in the mutual action plan).

Can you confirm the three agent IPs and whether they should be permanently whitelisted or allowed via a timeboxed exception? Once we have that, Monica and I will schedule a 60-minute technical workshop with your IdP owner and IT Ops.

Proposed workshop slots (PST): Monday 2027-01-18 09:00, 11:00, or 15:00. Please pick one and we'll send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead — Redwood Inference
